name: grotec-farmos-crm
description: GROTEC FarmerOS — CRM (5-month incremental build). Monorepo: Backend + Frontend + Shared.

scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace @grotec/backend && npm run build --workspace @grotec/backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @grotec/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @grotec/shared && npm run start:dev --workspace @grotec/backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @grotec/shared --if-present && npm run test --workspace @grotec/backend && npm run test --workspace @grotec/frontend
